evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: longitudinal vertical tear at the body and the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with flipped into intercondylar region.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: the lateral meniscus is not torn.
evidence.Medial OA: diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along weightbaring, non weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion.
evidence.Contusion: Bone marrow edema at the femur at the origin site of LCL, Popliteus tendon
